title: Sprout and apple slaw on toast with cheddar

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Sprouts, apples, walnuts, Greek yoghurt, mustard, honey, bread and cheddar are all ordinary home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every item is an everyday line at Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a pan, bowl, grater, knife and toaster, and the slicing is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: 300g of sprouts with two apples, a lightly dressed slaw and 80g of cheddar over four slices of toast makes a sensible snack for four, and the lemon stops the apple browning.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is realistic for slicing 300g of sprouts thinly, cutting the apple matchsticks and making the dressing, and the 10-minute rest matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon, is used, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: Raw shredded sprouts are clearly the point of the dish, and a winter slaw on hot toast with cheddar suits early January.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a satisfying snack of vegetables, fruit, nuts, cheese and wholemeal bread with only a touch of honey.
